bullets_zh: 该版本修复了MOABB与pyRiemann均值API的兼容问题。
在TRCA和TRCSP中使用gmean，以支持pyRiemann 0.12及当前0.13开发版。
新增针对TRCSP度量和TRCA协方差的回归测试覆盖。
bullets_en: Release fixes MOABB compatibility with pyRiemann mean APIs.
Uses gmean in TRCA and TRCSP for pyRiemann 0.12 and current 0.13 support.
Adds regression coverage for TRCSP metrics and TRCA covariance.
items.brief: 修复pyRiemann兼容，提升EEG基准评测稳定性。
items.brief_en: Fixes pyRiemann compatibility to keep EEG benchmark evaluation stable.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.2 fixes compatibility with pyRiemann mean APIs. - Use `gmean` in TRCA and TRCSP, supporting pyRiemann 0.12 and current 0.13 development versions. - Pass the TRCSP metric by keyword to fix fitting with pyRiemann 0.12. - Add regression coverage for three TRCSP metrics and two TRCA covariance means. This patch release is based on v1.7.1 and includes the fix from [#1180](https://github.com/N

bullets_zh: 当NEMAR因代理或HTTP传输失败而不可达时，仍可使用本地缓存的上游数据。
在NEMAR下载边界捕获泄漏的httpx.TransportError异常。
保留默认auto提供程序回退到数据集自身下载链接的行为。
bullets_en: Keeps locally cached upstream data usable if NEMAR fails via proxy or HTTP transport.
Catches leaked httpx.TransportError exceptions at NEMAR download boundaries.
Preserves default auto provider fallback to dataset-specific downloads.
items.brief: 增强NEMAR不可达时本地缓存数据可用性。
items.brief_en: Improves local cached dataset availability when NEMAR is unreachable.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.1 keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through a proxy or another HTTP transport failure. - Catch leaked `httpx.TransportError` exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries. - Preserve the default `auto` provider fallback to the dataset's own downloader. See [PR #1171](https://github.com/NeuroTechX/moabb/pull/1171).

bullets_zh: BaseDataset.get_data在NEMAR预取前使用完整的处理缓存。
当NEMAR或网络不可用时，已缓存数据集仍可继续使用。
dataset_bubble_plot的布局变为可复现。
bullets_en: BaseDataset.get_data uses a complete processing cache before NEMAR prefetch.
Cached datasets remain usable when NEMAR or the network is unavailable.
dataset_bubble_plot layout becomes reproducible.
items.brief: 修复离线缓存访问并使气泡图可复现。
items.brief_en: Fixes offline cached-data access and makes dataset bubble plots reproducible.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.0 fixes offline cached-data access and makes dataset bubble plots reproducible. - `BaseDataset.get_data` now uses a complete processing cache before NEMAR prefetch, so cached datasets remain usable when NEMAR or the network is unavailable. - `dataset_bubble_plot` now has reproducible layouts by default and accepts `random_state` for controlled alternatives. Full changelog: https://moabb.

bullets_zh: MOABB 提交 #1168 用显式 random_state 参数替代全局 NumPy 随机状态。
固定默认值使重复生成的六边形受试者布局图在多次运行中保持一致。
该改动提升了 EEG/BCI 基准测试中数据集可视化的可复现性。
bullets_en: MOABB commit #1168 replaces global NumPy random state with an explicit random_state parameter.
A fixed default makes repeated hexagonal subject-layout figures identical across runs.
The change improves reproducibility of dataset visualization in EEG/BCI benchmarking.
items.brief: MOABB 改进气泡图随机状态，提升数据集可视化可复现性。
items.brief_en: MOABB adds explicit random_state to bubble plots, improving reproducible visualization for EEG/BCI benchmarking.
items.raw_excerpt: ENH Make dataset bubble plots reproducible (#1168) ENH Make dataset bubble plots reproducible Replace the global NumPy random state used by the hexagonal subject layout with an explicit random_state parameter. bullets_zh: MOABB 提交 #1169 在本地缓存可用时避免不必要的 NEMAR 预取。
它在移除缓存后仍保留原有的 NEMAR-first 行为。
该更新减少了使用缓存数据集的 EEG/BCI 基准用户的重复下载。
bullets_en: MOABB commit #1169 avoids unnecessary NEMAR prefetch when local cache is available.
It preserves the original NEMAR-first behavior after cache removal.
The update reduces redundant downloads for EEG/BCI benchmark users working with cached datasets.
items.brief: MOABB 优化 NEMAR 数据缓存逻辑，减少重复下载。
